trigger: NAAMP_JOINT_SPECIES_LOCAL_MEMORY_NULL_V0_1 rejected at plus-one Monte Carlo P=0.000999, activating exactly this one fallback under MECHANISM_DECISION_TREE_V0_1.
question: Does rainfall selectively gate reactivation toward historically favored, currently silent species x physical-SiteID cells strongly enough to reproduce the observed four-component matrix allocation?
population: Exactly the same 2,916 physically stable, strictly-prior-history-eligible pairs across 439 routes used by the joint species-memory null.

base_process.local_memory: Strictly-prior species x physical-SiteID probabilities from NAAMP_PRIOR_LOCAL_MEMORY_NULL_V0_1, kappa=2 smoothing.
base_process.species_shift: Existing route-cross-fit species gamma from NAAMP_CROSSFIT_SPECIES_SHIFT_NULL_V0_1; each held-out route uses gamma learned only from the opposite SHA256 route fold.
base_process.magnitude: One common pair-level shift is always solved so expected wet incidence equals observed wet incidence count.

gating_score.raw: For each pair and species, p_prior at each of the 10 focal physical SiteIDs.
gating_score.centered: m = p_prior - mean(p_prior across the 10 focal SiteIDs for that species).
gating_score.currently_silent_only: m_gate = m when focal dry cell=0; m_gate=0 when dry cell=1.
gating_score.rationale: The interaction redistributes new activation among historically favored versus disfavored currently-silent sites without changing species-level prior prevalence or directly modifying persistent dry-positive cells.

lambda_crossfit.folds: Same deterministic SHA256 State:RouteNumber A/B split as the species-shift null.
lambda_crossfit.training: For test fold A use lambda_B learned only on eligible fold-B pairs; for test fold B use lambda_A learned only on eligible fold-A pairs.
lambda_crossfit.objective: Choose one scalar lambda per training fold to maximize Bernoulli log-likelihood of observed wet species x stop cells after solving a separate common pair shift at every candidate lambda so each training pair's expected total wet incidence equals its observed wet incidence.
lambda_crossfit.stability_gate: Both optimizers must succeed and abs(lambda)<9.9. If either fails/hits the bound, no mechanism sufficiency conclusion is authorized.

primary_test: Held-out cross-fit simulation of the same corner/spatial/taxonomic/within-core rain-contrast beta vector; same Mahalanobis plus-one Monte Carlo omnibus.

prefixed_decision.p_ge_0_05: Stop mechanism escalation. Cross-fit rain-gated local memory plus cross-fit species response and dry persistence is sufficient under this null family.
prefixed_decision.p_lt_0_05: Stop mechanism escalation. Even the final held-out rain-by-memory gate is insufficient; conclude structured recurrent activation is real but the public observational data do not identify a sufficient lower-level generator.

prohibited: No additional traits, site-specific rainfall coefficients, alternative interaction forms, threshold retuning or new mechanism models after this result.
No RC11 submission change from this exploratory test.
Failure to reject is sufficiency under the tested null, not unique causal proof.
No continuous occupancy, individual fidelity, abundance, breeding success or causal rainfall claim.
